--8<-- [start:time_goal_1]
test("time") <- time_goal(append([1, 2], [3, 4], _))
--8<-- [end:time_goal_1]

--8<-- [start:time_goal_2]
test("measure") <- (
    time_goal(length(LIST, 1000), SECS),
    SECS < 1.0
)
--8<-- [end:time_goal_2]

--8<-- [start:benchmark_recipe]
compare_approaches(GOAL_A, GOAL_B) <- (
    time_goal(GOAL_A, TIME_A),
    time_goal(GOAL_B, TIME_B),
    FASTER == (TIME_A < TIME_B),
    writeln_text(f"A: {TIME_A}s, B: {TIME_B}s")
)
--8<-- [end:benchmark_recipe]
